model.title: Taxpayer Workforce Modernization Act
model.meta: Ways and Means Committee · Rep. David Schweikert (R-AZ)

summary.text: The bill would require the IRS to create a fellowship program hiring data scientists to work alongside tax experts on improving tax administration. The program aims to enhance audit selection, combat offshore tax evasion, and advance the use of artificial intelligence and data analytics in IRS operations.
